2981-3139-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2981-3139-5660-6769.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
2981-3139-5660-6769.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}. 
When The Great Henge enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing The Great Henge, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

391-2645-3257-3430.easyPrerequisites: Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
391-2645-3257-3430.description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

277-5531-5694-7874-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-5531-5694-7874-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the The Immortal Weapons trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-5531-5694-7874-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink The Immortal Weapons and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

549-997-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-997-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Woe Strider.

4399-4518-5998-7399.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Bogwater Lumaret trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-5998-7399.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

457-1458-2906-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-2906-4404.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
457-1458-2906-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Rakdos.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

372-2187-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2187-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Possessed Skaab and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Possessed Skaab trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6719-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6719-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1017-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

413-2173-5010-5708.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2178-4170-4871-6797.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
2178-4170-4871-6797.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

222-527-997-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-997-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

997-1580-4647-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1987-2364-2468-2751.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mana Vault and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

678-4050-4151-6441.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
678-4050-4151-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
678-4050-4151-6441.description:
Cast Vishgraz either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1322-1374-3626-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1322-1374-3626-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

527-1432-4513.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}.
Activate Saryth by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Saryth and Selvala
Repeat.

2498-4126.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2498-4126.description:
Draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to draw two cards due to Nefarious Lich.
Repeat step 2.

2034-3297-3413.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Human.
2034-3297-3413.description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Zombie" on Xathrid Necromancer to "Human" until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other Human, adding {C}{C}.
Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Human creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
